_comment: Update manifest. `web` is the latest web build — it MUST equal the ?v=N in index.html on every release (scripts/release.js writes both); js/update.js reads it fresh (no-store) and reloads the entry html so web/CSS/JS updates reach all devices without a reinstall. `apk` only triggers the in-app download banner when apk.build here is GREATER than the versionCode installed on the device. To release a NEW APK: bump android/app/build.gradle versionCode + versionName, `npm run sync`, build, commit the APK to download/THE-VAULT.apk, then set apk.build/apk.version here to the same numbers (scripts/check-contracts.js refuses a mismatch) and push.

apk.notes_ar: الحدّ الأدنى لإصدار WebView صار ٨٠: الهاتف الذي كان يفتح التطبيق على شاشة فارغة بسبب WebView قديم يرى الآن رسالة تحديث واضحة بدل الفراغ. لا تغيير آخر في القشرة — كل التحديثات تصلك عبر الرابط الحيّ كما هي.
apk.notes_en: Minimum WebView is now 80: a phone that opened the app to a blank screen because of an old WebView now sees a clear update prompt instead. Nothing else changed in the shell — every update still reaches you through the live URL.
